create_cnnmodel_from_config: create a CNNModel instance from a Config object with source and target dictionaries and embeddings
run_cnnmodel_forward: run the CNNModel forward pass with source tokens, additional features, and previous output tokens
get_normalized_probs_cnnmodel: get normalized probabilities from the CNNModel decoder output for a given sample
validate_cnnmodel_config: validate that the CNNModel encoder max positions do not exceed the decoder max positions
create_decoupled_cnnmodel: create a DecoupledCNNModel with a LightConvDecoupledDecoder instead of the standard LightConvDecoder
